ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with a dominant low-intensity (black) base covering approximately 85% of the surface area, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous distribution of white ring-shaped and circular geometric blobs across both lateral lobes. Higher density of high-intensity pixels on the outer distal regions; the central region adjacent to the peduncle remains a contiguous low-intensity dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant vertical penetration into the fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of jagged peaks is more pronounced on the upper-left quadrant compared to the more uniform right quadrant.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-curve trajectory characterized by a convex expansion from the median notch followed by a narrowing taper towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, varying in diameter from 5 to 40 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of high-relief, irregular white/grey pixel masses concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes, indicating significant structural accumulation or trauma localized to the distal edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Dominance of 'hollow' ring-shaped pixel patterns across the ventral surface, creating a distinct negative-space effect within the white markings.
